mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_question (answer_id, report_id, question, focus_codes_json, idempotency_key, response_json, result_code, created_at) VALUES (#{answerId}, #{reportId}, #{question}, #{focusCodesJson}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{responseJson}, #{resultCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT answer_id AS answerId, report_id AS reportId, question, focus_codes_json AS focusCodesJson, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, response_json AS responseJson, result_code AS resultCode, created_at AS createdAt FROM report_question WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
